title_zh: 确认历史导览的建筑与集合点

scenario.label_zh: 核对宫殿与旧监狱导览路线
scenario.goal_zh: 确认历史导览涉及的建筑、入内范围及集合安排

context_zh: 游客向一座虚构古城的导览员询问参观路线和是否进入建筑内部。
author: author-phase04-b

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: Does the walking tour include the old palace?

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: Yes. We stop outside it and explain why the queen moved her court there. Then we visit the former prison across the square.

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: Do we go inside both buildings?

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: Only the prison. The palace rooms are closed today, but the outside is part of the tour.

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: That is fine. Where does the tour meet?

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: Beside the clock in the square, at two.

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: I will meet you by the clock at two, then.
